theme: After Black Friday agent commerce, today's fight is access and measurement: Cloudflare indexes the open web for agents, Google forces Workspace through MCP+CLI, Obsidian teaches agents your notes, Cashfree lets them pay bills. Anthropic Siren measures whether they will jump a weak sandbox. ShellBench, AgenticPPL and a Hugging Face 1000-agent swarm measure everyday work, command tokens, and collaboration at scale. Cognition ships SWE-2.1 into Devin.
